title: CompTIA Network+ Study Bank
summary: Core networking track covering the OSI model, IPv4/IPv6 subnetting, routing & switching, wireless, network operations, security hardening, and troubleshooting.

domains.title: Networking Concepts
domains.description: OSI layers, encapsulation, ports & protocols, IPv4 subnetting, IPv6 addressing, cloud/modern network architectures, and physical media.

domains.title: Network Implementation
domains.description: Routing technologies (OSPF, BGP, FHRP), switching (VLANs, 802.1Q trunking, STP, LACP), and 802.11 wireless deployments.

domains.title: Network Operations
domains.description: Organizational documentation, telemetry (SNMP, Syslog, NetFlow), DNS record types, DHCP relay/scopes, NTP, and high availability.

domains.title: Network Security
domains.description: Defense-in-depth, 802.1X/NAC, RADIUS/TACACS+, Layer 2 attacks (ARP spoofing, DHCP snooping, DAI), VPNs, and firewall ACLs.

domains.title: Network Troubleshooting
domains.description: CompTIA 7-step troubleshooting methodology, cable/signal issues, Layer 2/Layer 3/wireless faults, and CLI/hardware diagnostic tools.
